title: LPDDR5X_Lite: LPDDR5X-style line controller: 8 banks, per-bank refresh in rotation and on request, two FSP register sets (CL / CWL per set, FSPW), WCK through the write path, DDR4_Lite timing

regs.name: CMD
regs.desc: Host command beat; writing CMD2 sends it: a command, or one of the 8 data beats that follow a WRITE

fdesc.hcmd: command (see the notes); ignored on a data beat
fdesc.haddr: host address (see the notes); ignored on a data beat
fdesc.hwdata: MRW value (bits 7:0), or the data beat of a WRITE (beat 0 = line bits 15:0)

fields.desc: {8'h0, MR value} after an MRR (also carries read beats while a READ drains)

regs.name: RLINE
regs.desc: Line of the last READ (RLINE0 = bits 31:0)

fields.desc: the 128-bit line of the last READ, held until the next READ completes
active frequency set point (FSPW); same as the fsp pin

irqs.name: DONE
irqs.desc: a command finished (READ: RLINE holds the line; MRR: RDATA holds the value)

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: a command was rejected (out-of-range address) or a refresh overran; the core holds this until reset, so the bit cannot be cleared before then

notes: haddr: [9:7] bank, [18:10] row, [6:4] line; [31:19] must be 0 for READ / WRITE. hcmd 0 NOP, 1 READ line, 2 WRITE line (then 8 data beats), 3 MRW / 4 MRR (active set, haddr[2:0], hwdata[7:0]), 5 REFRESH all banks, 6 REFRESH bank haddr[9:7], 7 FSPW (hwdata[0]).
The DRAM pins (ck_t, ck_c, cke, cs_n, act_n, ras_n, cas_n, we_n, ba, addr, dq, dqs, wck_t, wck_c) and the command trace pass through unchanged.
The core's own verification (pin-level checker, 100% coverage) is tb/cov/LPDDR5X_Lite_sva.sv with tb/LPDDR5X_Lite_tb.sv; this wrapper test drives the core only through the registers.
